name: inline-paste
description: Keeps pastes and voice dictations editable: anything up to a limit you choose (2,500 characters by default) is shown in full in the prompt box instead of a [Pasted text] placeholder.

maxChars.title: Largest paste to show in full (characters)
maxChars.description: Pastes up to this many characters are shown as editable text. Longer ones stay folded as [Pasted text]. Default 2500.

debug.title: Debug lines
debug.description: Print a dim line in the transcript saying why each paste was or was not expanded.
